jobs.title: Director, Applications, Data & Integration
jobs.description:
Job Description

Our client is seeking an experienced and strategic Director, Applications, Data & Integration to join a growing Digital Business Services team. This leadership role is responsible for building and leading enterprise application, data, and integration capabilities while driving modernization through AI-assisted engineering, modern DevOps practices, and enterprise data management. The position plays a key role in the organization's long-term digital and technology transformation strategy.

Responsibilities

Applications & Software Engineering Leadership

Provide technical leadership and architecture oversight across the enterprise application landscape.
Establish application architecture, development, and lifecycle standards.
Guide solution design for new applications and major enhancements.
Partner with Product Owners to translate business requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
Provide technical oversight of implementation partners and third-party development resources.
Build and mature software engineering practices, including development standards, source control, code reviews, testing, and documentation.
Establish CI/CD, environment management, and release management capabilities to support controlled and repeatable deployments.
Embed application security and secure development practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted development practices to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and delivery.
Drive significant improvements in engineering productivity while maintaining security, quality, and appropriate human oversight.
Strengthen automated testing, application monitoring, and overall technical quality.

Integration Architecture

Own enterprise integration architecture and technical integration standards.
Establish consistent approaches for APIs, interfaces, and system-to-system data exchange.
Ensure integrations across the application landscape are secure, resilient, supportable, and appropriately monitored.
Maintain an architectural view of how applications, integrations, and data work together across the enterprise.

Enterprise Applications & Platform Leadership

Provide technical leadership for enterprise business platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 and related technologies.
Work with Product Owners and implementation partners on architecture, integration, and technical design.
Build sufficient internal capability to support, maintain, and extend business platforms over time.
Ensure platform development aligns with engineering, security, and application management standards.

Data & Analytics

Develop enterprise data architecture and technical data management practices.
Build data engineering capabilities to integrate, transform, and make trusted data available across the organization.
Establish approaches for master data management, data quality, lineage, and technical controls.
Build and lead emerging data engineering and analytics capabilities.
Enable consistent enterprise reporting and analytics.
Partner with business stakeholders on data ownership and governance.

People Leadership

Build and lead teams spanning application development, integration, quality assurance, data engineering, and analytics.
Develop technical staff and establish clear engineering expectations and practices.
Determine the appropriate balance of internal capabilities, implementation partners, and specialized contractors.
Foster a culture focused on technical quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and effective use of AI-assisted development.

Security & Operational Excellence

Partner with IT Operations to ensure applications and integrations meet security, resilience, and operational requirements.
Embed security-by-design principles into application architecture and engineering practices.
Ensure solutions incorporate appropriate access controls, data protection, monitoring, and operational support requirements.

Qualifications

Required

Progressive technology leadership experience across enterprise applications, software engineering, integration, and data.
Demonstrated experience building or maturing software engineering and DevOps practices.
Strong understanding of modern application architecture, APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms.
Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, secure development, and application lifecycle management.
Experience adopting modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software delivery.
Experience with data architecture, data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and external technology partners.
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and business leaders.

Preferred

Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Dynamics 365 and the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
Experience leading enterprise technology modernization, digital transformation, or platform modernization initiatives.

Affinity Earn

Know someone who’s great for this, or any of our open roles? Earn up to $4,000/year for each successful referral through Affinity Earn. You can also earn up to $50,000 for helping us find new clients. Learn about our referral program at https://affinity-group.ca/earn/ or browse our jobs & follow us at https://www.linkedin.com/company/affinity-staffing/jobs/

We believe in creating long term relationships between clients and consultants that foster a mutually beneficial partnership. Affinity is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Department: Finance and Corporate Services Dept.

Job Category: Management 

Application Close: 23/10/2026

Job Summary

You are accountable for providing corporate leadership and strategic planning for the City's information technology function in support of City operations, corporate priorities and the delivery of municipal programs and services.

You are accountable for the leadership, delivery and continuous improvement of the Service's priorities, services, programs and operations, including enterprise technology and artificial intelligence strategy and governance, technology architecture, roadmaps and investment planning, enterprise applications and digital capabilities, technology infrastructure and asset management, and workplace technology and user support services.

You provide strategic technology and artificial intelligence advice to the General Manager, City Manager, senior leaders and Council on matters affecting technology services, digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, investments, risks and organizational priorities. You ensure information security, privacy, data governance, accessibility, ethical use and digital risk requirements are integrated into technology and artificial intelligence strategies, investments, services and operational practices.

You are also accountable for the effective management of the Service’s human and financial resources, including contracted services, and for maintaining productive relationships with internal and external partners while fostering corporate alignment, continuous improvement and service excellence.

Education And Experience

Completion of 4 year university degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Public Administration or other related field.

Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible senior leadership experience in technology and artificial intelligence strategy, governance, digital transformation, service delivery, enterprise applications and technology infrastructure within a large, complex public-sector or comparable environment, including a minimum of 5 years leading multidisciplinary teams, organizational change and adoption, external contract resources, and operating and capital budgets.

KNOWLEDGE

Principles, practices, legislation, regulations, standards and governance frameworks related to information technology services, programs and operations
Enterprise technology strategy, governance, architecture, roadmaps and investment planning
Enterprise applications and digital capabilities, technology infrastructure and asset management, workplace technology and user support services
Industry trends, emerging technologies, developments, leading practices and service delivery models
Artificial intelligence technologies, enterprise AI platforms, adoption approaches, operating models and lifecycle management
Responsible AI principles and governance, including human oversight, transparency, fairness, accessibility, privacy, security, data governance, records management, procurement and risk management
Enterprise AI adoption and enablement practices, including use-case evaluation, prioritization, implementation, performance measurement and value realization
Organizational change management, workforce enablement, digital literacy and technology adoption practices
Information security, privacy and digital risk principles and requirements as they relate to technology services and operations
Public sector governance, public administration, policy development and business administration principles and practices
Principles and methods of economic, financial, social and political risk analysis
Project management principles and practices
The City of Ottawa, its operations, corporate governance structure, priorities and decision-making processes
Relevant legislation, regulations, City policies and procedures
Public-private partnerships and other alternative service delivery models
Human resource management practices in a unionized work environment
Must be familiar with applicable health and safety legislation, have knowledge of any potential or actual danger to health or safety in the workplace, and have knowledge of appropriate actions to be taken to ensure the health and safety of staff in accordance with applicable legislation and City policies and procedures

Core Behaviours

Core behaviours define the City's expectations of the behaviours employees should demonstrate in performing their work. They are reflective of the City's culture and values and guide all our present and future activities. Every employee is encouraged to learn, embody, and demonstrate these core behaviours.

Review the Core Behaviours .

jobs.title: Associate Director, Business Data Office, Data Integrity & Operations
jobs.description:
Experience something Brilliantly Different with MUFG Investor Services.  

MUFG Investor Services is a trusted partner to many of the world’s largest public and private funds, providing asset servicing and operational solutions built for alternatives. With over $1 trillion in client assets under administration, we offer fund administration, banking, payments, fund financing, foreign exchange overlay, corporate and regulatory services, custody, business consulting, and more. Operating from 17 locations worldwide, we help clients mitigate risk, enhance efficiency, and navigate the operational complexities of today’s investment management landscape. As a division of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s largest financial institutions with approximately $3 trillion in assets, we combine deep expertise with the strength and stability of a leading financial institution.

To learn more, visit us at www.mufg-investorservices.com.

Job Description

You will be responsible for ensuring the operational integrity and continuous improvement of core business data domains. The role combines ownership of daily data operations, including MDM data supply and issue management, with leadership of data outcomes across change initiatives to ensure data is accurate, controlled, and fit for purpose across the enterprise.

Own the daily operation of the MDM platform, including data ingestion, processing, and controlled execution of the data diffing and reconciliation process to ensure accurate and timely data supply.
Lead the end-to-end management of data requests through Jira Service Management, ensuring effective prioritisation, resolution, root cause linkage, and reduction of recurring issues.
Take accountability for data integrity across domains, ensuring data is accurate, consistent, and aligned to business, regulatory, and operational requirements.
Manage data quality measurement, including definition of rules, monitoring of key quality dimensions, and tracking of metrics such as exception rates, resolution times, data health trends, and overall control effectiveness.
Drive performance against key operational targets, including achieving a zero-diff position, reducing ticket backlog, and improving data quality metrics across domains.
Lead root cause analysis of data issues and implement sustainable remediation actions that address systemic failures and improve data quality at source.
Lead the delivery of data requirements within projects and change initiatives, ensuring data integrity controls, lineage, quality rules, and documentation are fully implemented.
Define and embed data standards and control requirements within MDM processes, data quality rules, and project delivery to ensure consistency and enforceability.
Drive continuous improvement across MDM operations, diffing, and issue management processes, increasing automation and shifting from reactive issue resolution to proactive data control.
Provide clear, outcome-focused reporting on operational performance, including data supply health, diff position, ticket backlog, and data quality metrics to support decision-making.

Qualifications

You Have:

7–10+ years of experience in data management, data operations, or data architecture within large, complex enterprise environments.
Proven experience owning operational data processes, including data supply pipelines, MDM processing, and issue management frameworks.
Experience leading data workstreams within projects or change initiatives, ensuring delivery of data requirements end-to-end.
Strong expertise in master and reference data management, data quality frameworks, metadata, and data governance practices.
Hands-on experience with Jira Service Management or equivalent tools for operational workflow and issue tracking.
Experience with enterprise data tooling such as Informatica, Collibra, Purview, Alation, or similar platforms beneficial.
Advanced SQL and strong hands-on experience working with complex, high-volume datasets.
Proficiency in Python or similar tools to support analysis, validation, and automation.
Deep understanding of end-to-end data flows, including lineage, transformations, integration patterns, and control points.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence business and technology leaders through data-led insights, issue resolution, and delivery of data integrity outcomes across operations and change initiatives.
Experience mentoring team members and driving consistent ways of working across teams.
Experience working in regulated environments such as financial services, risk, or compliance is advantageous.

Additional Information

What’s in it for you to join MUFG Investor Services? 

Take a look at our careers site and you’ll find everything you’d expect working with one of the fastest-growing businesses at one of the world’s largest financial groups. Now take another look. Because it’s how we defy expectations that really defines us. You’ll feel that difference in all kinds of ways.  Our vibrant CULTURE. Connected team. Love of innovation, laser client focus. 

So, why settle for the ordinary?  Apply now for your next Brilliantly Different opportunity. 

We are committed to using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools responsibly and being transparent about what we do to build trust and confidence. All AI recommendations are reviewed by our recruitment team before any decisions are made.

More information on our use of AI tools is available in our Privacy Notice available to you as part of your application.

We thank all candidates for applying; however, only those proceeding to the interview stage will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation is a critical enabler of Finance modernization and enterprise scale. This role owns the strategy, architecture, and execution of finance systems, integrations, and automation — ensuring that financial data, workflows, and insights flow seamlessly across the organization and franchise network.

As 1-800-GOT-JUNK? evolves toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will help shift Finance from manual processes to a connected, technology-enabled ecosystem. They will partner closely with Finance, Product, and Technology leaders to ensure financial systems evolve in lockstep with new products, pricing models, payment flows, and operating rhythms.

The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation combines financial process knowledge with systems thinking, technical fluency, and cross-functional leadership. They bring structure to complexity, simplify workflows, and ensure Finance technology supports better decisions — not just better reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Product, and the Field
. The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation enables Finance to move faster, think smarter, and scale confidently — automating the manual, simplifying the complex, and ensuring financial systems support the company’s next phase of growth.

Your Impact & What You'll Own

Finance Systems Strategy & Architecture: Own the end-to-end finance systems architecture, ensuring alignment across ERP, CRM, payments, FP&A, and BI platforms. Design scalable, resilient system landscapes that support growth, product expansion, and franchise complexity. Act as the enterprise steward of how financial data moves, connects, and is consumed.
Integration & Data Flow Enablement: Lead the design and delivery of system integrations using integration platforms and native APIs. Ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data flows between finance, product, and operational systems.Establish data governance principles that support a single source of truth and enterprise confidence in financial data.
Product & Technology Partnership: Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure finance systems support new products, pricing models, and customer journeys. Translate financial requirements into system capabilities early in the product lifecycle. Support experimentation and iteration while maintaining financial discipline and controls.
Leadership, Delivery & Governance: Lead and develop a high-performing team and vendor ecosystem. Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and drive delivery with accountability. Establish governance for finance systems changes, enhancements, and adoption.
Automation & Process Modernization: Lead the roadmap to automate and optimize core finance processes, including close, AR/AP, forecasting, and reporting. Reduce manual effort and operational risk by simplifying workflows and eliminating redundant processes. Ensure automation efforts balance efficiency, control, and business usability.
Franchise & Field Enablement: Collaborate with franchise partners and field teams to design integrations and tools that simplify their financial workflows. Ensure finance systems scale across the franchise network while respecting local realities and adoption needs. Act as a bridge between enterprise systems and on-the-ground execution.

What You Bring To The Table

8 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, systems architecture, financial technology, enterprise applications, or finance technology transformation, with a strong track record of building and scaling technology solutions.
Strong engineering and coding foundation — with hands-on experience in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and the ability to write, review, troubleshoot, and understand production code. Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, databases, data pipelines, and integration frameworks.
Advanced integration and data-flow expertise — proven ability to connect systems and make them work together across platforms, data warehouses, and SaaS applications using APIs, middleware, integration platforms, and custom solutions, while ensuring reliable, accurate, and traceable data flows.
Strong technical understanding of modern data and cloud architecture, including relational databases, SQL, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, event-driven integrations, and integration technologies. Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or similar is highly valued.
Systems thinker and problem solver who can look across the entire technology ecosystem, identify gaps and points of failure, and determine whether the right solution is configuration, integration, automation, or custom development.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building from the ground up — able to simplify complex problems, make pragmatic technology decisions, and create scalable solutions without over-engineering. Ability to work closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams and translate between business needs and technical solutions.
Builder mentality — curious, hands-on, and willing to get into the details. You don't just identify that two systems need to connect; you understand how they should connect and can work with engineers or vendors to make it happen.
Understanding of finance processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, month-end close, revenue and payments is an asset
Experience working with Netsuite or finance systems and applications is an asset

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $159,000 to $186,000 per annum (The actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience, and internal parity)
Health & Dental: The Total Compensation Package includes Extended Health and dental coverage.
Professional Growth: We focus on your development through our professional development programs.
Wellness: Enjoy a variety of health and wellness initiatives, including access to gym facilities at our corporate head office.
Transparency: Speak to us to learn more about the full details of what we offer.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Our Model: We have created a hybrid work model that helps us get together to Collaborate, Celebrate, and Connect while enjoying flexibility.
Office Presence: For this role’s duty and responsibility, we anticipate that you will come into the office three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday.

THE HIRING PROCESS

Pre-Screen: Let’s talk about your experience, goals, and excitement for this role.
Interviews: Our process is designed to be both engaging and transparent, as we know this is as big of a decision for you as it is for us.
Verification: We conduct reference and background checks as part of our final steps.
Modern Practices: We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices.

About Us

Award-Winning Culture: O2E Brands has been named one of Canada’s Best Workplaces 14 times.
Global Recognition: We made Newsweek’s top 100 list of “Most Loved Workplaces” at #14—the only Canadian company on the list!
Social Presence: Check out our culture on YouTube and social media to see what life is like here.
Inclusivity: We value diversity and inclusivity; accommodations are available upon request.

jobs.description:
Job Description

On behalf of our public-sector client, Affinity is seeking a Chief Courts Information Officer to be accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, and delivery of information management (IM), information technology (IT), and digital services for the Courts. The CCIO ensures that court information systems, digital services, and technology investments support judicial independence, court administration, access to justice, operational efficiency, privacy, and security.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement information management strategies and polices to ensure the secure and efficient handling of Court information.
Project management, change management and strategic planning processes for the effective delivery and management of both short and long-term information technology goals set by the judiciary.
Represent the interests of the judiciary recognizing judicial independence in their day-today operations of and/or projects involving implementing and/or updating software, databases and digital tools used by the judiciary or involving judicial data and court information.
Must operate with full confidence of the Chief Justices and the Chief Judge, be discreet as required and understand the highly confidential and sensitive nature of the work that they perform.
The Chief Court Information Officer (“CCIO”) must have the ability to work cooperatively and harmoniously with all members of the judiciary and both senior and front-line court administration staff, as we as internal and external stakeholders.
Lead the modernization of court information systems, including case management, e-filing, digital evidence, and courtroom technology.

Qualifications

Education and/or training involving computer science, information technology, cyber security or related field.
Significant work experience, preferably 5 years or more, in information technology and information governance, with a focus on cybersecurity and records retention.
Strong understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to information management, cybersecurity, and records retention.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop and implement effective information management strategies for an increasingly digital legal work environment.
Extensive experience conducting IT and information security research and providing advice and opinions, preferably at a senior executive level.
Demonstrated ability to prepare written opinions, memoranda and reports.
The incumbent must have a superior understanding of the principles of judicial independence and possess strong political acumen and experience in the application of discretion and diplomacy to ensure positive outcomes and confidence in the administration of justice.
Well-developed planning and organizational skills in order to accomplish the position’s responsibilities and meet target dates and set priorities.
Experience using MS Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook and online legal research databases which may be used by the judiciary. Familiarity with JUDICLOUD (federally appointed judges email network) and/or PowerBI is considered an asset.
Stakeholder engagement - Build effective relationships with the judiciary, court administrators, justice partners, central government IT organizations, and external stakeholders.
Represent the Courts on inter jurisdictional, justice sector, and government technology forums, as required.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
On-site attendance is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Must be able to provide a satisfactory criminal record check and security clearance.
The Resource will be required to execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and maintain strict confidentiality with respect to all information obtained or accessed in the course of performing the Services.
Relevant certifications such as the Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
A law degree from an accredited university or college recognized in Manitoba.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader principal(e) d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur(trice) principal(e)), vous serez responsable des programmes de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance pour façonner des solutions, de la gestion de relations avec des clients et de l’exécution de nombreuses missions.

À ce titre, vous devrez faire ce qui suit :

Superviser simultanément la prestation de bout en bout de l’architecture de solutions et de nombreuses missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), la gestion financière, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Fournir des conseils sur les stratégies de transformation de la fonction finance et de planification d’entreprise.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture.
Diriger la définition des processus de planification pour l’état futur et des modèles d’exploitation en tirant parti des capacités d’Oracle EPM pour rehausser l’efficacité et les perspectives d’affaires.
Favoriser l’harmonisation entre les finances, les TI et les parties prenantes de la direction pour favoriser des processus décisionnels efficaces et veiller à la réussite des programmes.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris la gamme complète de modules EPBCS.
Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en obtenant un rendement élevé, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes et les régions.
Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant de solides relations.
Veiller à ce que les gens soient sur la même longueur d’onde et à ce que les priorités soient harmonisées aux objectifs d’affaires des clients et de Deloitte.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins huit années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision de programmes de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise pour améliorer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Expérience éprouvée en gestion de missions de grande envergure ou simultanées, ainsi qu’en gestion de l’exécution, des parties prenantes et des aspects financiers des missions.
Excellente expertise fonctionnelle liée aux plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS, PBCS et Hyperion Planning), et aux modules associés (Workforce, Capital, Project, Strategic Modelling).
Compréhension approfondie des processus de planification et d’analyse financières, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, la planification à long terme et la gestion du rendement.
Expérience de la gestion des aspects financiers des projets, de leur étendue et des risques liés aux missions complexes.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, règles d’affaires Essbase, création de scripts dans Groovy, et IPA REST).
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité à les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un titre professionnel (p. ex., CPA, MBA) est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex., certification Oracle Cloud EPM) : considérées comme un atout important.

Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 105,000 $ à 234,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada

jobs.description:
Job ID: #175355

Director of Finance

Treasury Board Secretariat

Full-time/Permanent

Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island
2 Positions available
Expires on: November 4, 2026

The Treasury Board Secretariat is committed to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Accessibility. Our goal is to build a public sector workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to promote welcoming, diverse, inclusive, respectful workplaces that are accessible to all. We welcome all interested individuals including Indigenous People, persons with disabilities, Black, racialized, ethnic and culturally diverse groups, as well as people regardless of their sexual orientation, gender identities, and gender expressions. Those looking for more information are invited to visit our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Policy.

The Director of Finance is a senior management position assigned to either the Department of Justice & Public Safety or the Departments of Economic Development, Trade & Artificial Intelligence/Workforce and Advanced Learning and is responsible to advise and support the Minister and Deputy Ministers. The Director provides senior management leadership in the financial administration of the Department, and provides oversight, direction and advice to maintain financial accountability for the Department.

The Director is responsible for all aspects of the Department’s financial and corporate management, including budgeting and financial planning, forecasting and financial reporting, internal controls, contracts and contribution agreements, compliance with Treasury Board Policies & Procedures, and Executive Council / Treasury Board Memoranda.

The Director provides advice to the Ministers, Deputy Ministers and Directors of the Department on all initiatives, programs and activities.

The Director and other staff assigned to the Department will provide financial support for capital projects and contract negotiations.

Duties will include but are not limited to:

Provide overall direction and leadership on the financial administration of the Department;
Direct the budget planning, forecasting and reporting processes, and provide leadership in setting financial objectives for the Department;
Advise and assist directors and managers in quarterly forecasting and annual budget preparations;
Develop annual departmental Operating and Capital Budgets;
Develop and monitor an appropriate system of internal controls to help safeguard the department and further its objectives. An effective system of internal controls function to minimize risks and protect assets, ensure accuracy of records, promote operational efficiency, and encourage adherence to policies, regulations, and legislation;
Provide high quality advice, assistance, and information to the Minister, Deputy Minister, and Department Divisions pertaining to the financial implications on strategic and operational planning;
Provide expert, contextualized advice on the financial implications for current policy and legislation and provide leadership and direction to planning, policy analysis and development, and legislative initiatives;
Provide overall direction and leadership to the financial administration of Capital projects;
Assist in negotiating federal cost shared agreements and administer specified financial responsibilities with respect to these agreements, including: coordinating claims, maintaining prescribed accountability measures, and managing audit processes;
Directing work plans and managing performance;
Other related duties.

Minimum Qualifications:

Applicants must have a Degree in Business Administration or related field, and a Professional Accounting Designation.
Extensive experience in leadership and financial management at a senior level, preferably management within the Public Service.
Requires extensive knowledge of enterprise-wide financial information systems or similar financial system.
Must have sound knowledge of accounting and audit principles.
Requires excellent organizational and communication skills, strong interpersonal, leadership, conflict resolution, and collaborative skills and the ability to plan and think strategically.
Excellent written/verbal communication skills are required.
Strong knowledge of Oracle, PeopleSoft, and internal computer applications (i.e. Excel, etc.) would be considered beneficial.
Demonstrated problem solving ability with the ability to negotiate with and motivate others.

Benefits:

4 weeks paid vacation annually, as per the Terms and Conditions for Excluded Employees
Up to $2,500 annual training funds
Hybrid options within PEI
Flexible working hours
Employee assistance program
Pension Plan
Employer-paid health and dental benefits

This competition may be used to fill future job vacancies.

Please Note: Please ensure the application clearly demonstrates how you meet the noted qualifications as applicants will be screened based on the information provided. We would like to thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Where possible, submitting an electronic resume or job application is preferred. Otherwise, please return forms to PEI Public Service Commission, P.O. Box 2000, Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, C1A 7N8.

IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE APPLICANT TO CONFIRM RECEIPT OF THE APPLICATION, BY TELEPHONE OR IN PERSON PRIOR TO THE CLOSING DATE.

Please ensure that the appropriate Posting ID number is stated on all application forms.

The Public Service is inspired to make a positive impact and proud to shape the future of our Island Community.

new_jobs.title: Director, Finance Technology & Transformation
new_jobs.description:
The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation is a critical enabler of Finance modernization and enterprise scale. This role owns the strategy, architecture, and execution of finance systems, integrations, and automation — ensuring that financial data, workflows, and insights flow seamlessly across the organization and franchise network.

As 1-800-GOT-JUNK? evolves toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will help shift Finance from manual processes to a connected, technology-enabled ecosystem. They will partner closely with Finance, Product, and Technology leaders to ensure financial systems evolve in lockstep with new products, pricing models, payment flows, and operating rhythms.

The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation combines financial process knowledge with systems thinking, technical fluency, and cross-functional leadership. They bring structure to complexity, simplify workflows, and ensure Finance technology supports better decisions — not just better reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Product, and the Field
. The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation enables Finance to move faster, think smarter, and scale confidently — automating the manual, simplifying the complex, and ensuring financial systems support the company’s next phase of growth.

Your Impact & What You'll Own

Finance Systems Strategy & Architecture: Own the end-to-end finance systems architecture, ensuring alignment across ERP, CRM, payments, FP&A, and BI platforms. Design scalable, resilient system landscapes that support growth, product expansion, and franchise complexity. Act as the enterprise steward of how financial data moves, connects, and is consumed.
Integration & Data Flow Enablement: Lead the design and delivery of system integrations using integration platforms and native APIs. Ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data flows between finance, product, and operational systems.Establish data governance principles that support a single source of truth and enterprise confidence in financial data.
Product & Technology Partnership: Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure finance systems support new products, pricing models, and customer journeys. Translate financial requirements into system capabilities early in the product lifecycle. Support experimentation and iteration while maintaining financial discipline and controls.
Leadership, Delivery & Governance: Lead and develop a high-performing team and vendor ecosystem. Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and drive delivery with accountability. Establish governance for finance systems changes, enhancements, and adoption.
Automation & Process Modernization: Lead the roadmap to automate and optimize core finance processes, including close, AR/AP, forecasting, and reporting. Reduce manual effort and operational risk by simplifying workflows and eliminating redundant processes. Ensure automation efforts balance efficiency, control, and business usability.
Franchise & Field Enablement: Collaborate with franchise partners and field teams to design integrations and tools that simplify their financial workflows. Ensure finance systems scale across the franchise network while respecting local realities and adoption needs. Act as a bridge between enterprise systems and on-the-ground execution.

What You Bring To The Table

8 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, systems architecture, financial technology, enterprise applications, or finance technology transformation, with a strong track record of building and scaling technology solutions.
Strong engineering and coding foundation — with hands-on experience in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and the ability to write, review, troubleshoot, and understand production code. Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, databases, data pipelines, and integration frameworks.
Advanced integration and data-flow expertise — proven ability to connect systems and make them work together across platforms, data warehouses, and SaaS applications using APIs, middleware, integration platforms, and custom solutions, while ensuring reliable, accurate, and traceable data flows.
Strong technical understanding of modern data and cloud architecture, including relational databases, SQL, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, event-driven integrations, and integration technologies. Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or similar is highly valued.
Systems thinker and problem solver who can look across the entire technology ecosystem, identify gaps and points of failure, and determine whether the right solution is configuration, integration, automation, or custom development.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building from the ground up — able to simplify complex problems, make pragmatic technology decisions, and create scalable solutions without over-engineering. Ability to work closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams and translate between business needs and technical solutions.
Builder mentality — curious, hands-on, and willing to get into the details. You don't just identify that two systems need to connect; you understand how they should connect and can work with engineers or vendors to make it happen.
Understanding of finance processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, month-end close, revenue and payments is an asset
Experience working with Netsuite or finance systems and applications is an asset

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $159,000 to $186,000 per annum (The actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience, and internal parity)
Health & Dental: The Total Compensation Package includes Extended Health and dental coverage.
Professional Growth: We focus on your development through our professional development programs.
Wellness: Enjoy a variety of health and wellness initiatives, including access to gym facilities at our corporate head office.
Transparency: Speak to us to learn more about the full details of what we offer.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Our Model: We have created a hybrid work model that helps us get together to Collaborate, Celebrate, and Connect while enjoying flexibility.
Office Presence: For this role’s duty and responsibility, we anticipate that you will come into the office three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday.

THE HIRING PROCESS

Pre-Screen: Let’s talk about your experience, goals, and excitement for this role.
Interviews: Our process is designed to be both engaging and transparent, as we know this is as big of a decision for you as it is for us.
Verification: We conduct reference and background checks as part of our final steps.
Modern Practices: We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices.

About Us

Award-Winning Culture: O2E Brands has been named one of Canada’s Best Workplaces 14 times.
Global Recognition: We made Newsweek’s top 100 list of “Most Loved Workplaces” at #14—the only Canadian company on the list!
Social Presence: Check out our culture on YouTube and social media to see what life is like here.
Inclusivity: We value diversity and inclusivity; accommodations are available upon request.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply today!

Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en obtenant un rendement élevé, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes et les régions.
Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant de solides relations.
Veiller à ce que les gens soient sur la même longueur d’onde et à ce que les priorités soient harmonisées aux objectifs d’affaires des clients et de Deloitte.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins huit années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision de programmes de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise pour améliorer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Expérience éprouvée en gestion de missions de grande envergure ou simultanées, ainsi qu’en gestion de l’exécution, des parties prenantes et des aspects financiers des missions.
Excellente expertise fonctionnelle liée aux plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS, PBCS et Hyperion Planning), et aux modules associés (Workforce, Capital, Project, Strategic Modelling).
Compréhension approfondie des processus de planification et d’analyse financières, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, la planification à long terme et la gestion du rendement.
Expérience de la gestion des aspects financiers des projets, de leur étendue et des risques liés aux missions complexes.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, règles d’affaires Essbase, création de scripts dans Groovy, et IPA REST).
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité à les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un titre professionnel (p. ex., CPA, MBA) est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex., certification Oracle Cloud EPM) : considérées comme un atout important.

Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 105,000 $ à 234,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada

new_jobs.description:
Job ID: #175355

Director of Finance

Treasury Board Secretariat

Full-time/Permanent

Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island
2 Positions available
Expires on: November 4, 2026

The Treasury Board Secretariat is committed to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Accessibility. Our goal is to build a public sector workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to promote welcoming, diverse, inclusive, respectful workplaces that are accessible to all. We welcome all interested individuals including Indigenous People, persons with disabilities, Black, racialized, ethnic and culturally diverse groups, as well as people regardless of their sexual orientation, gender identities, and gender expressions. Those looking for more information are invited to visit our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Policy.

The Director of Finance is a senior management position assigned to either the Department of Justice & Public Safety or the Departments of Economic Development, Trade & Artificial Intelligence/Workforce and Advanced Learning and is responsible to advise and support the Minister and Deputy Ministers. The Director provides senior management leadership in the financial administration of the Department, and provides oversight, direction and advice to maintain financial accountability for the Department.

The Director is responsible for all aspects of the Department’s financial and corporate management, including budgeting and financial planning, forecasting and financial reporting, internal controls, contracts and contribution agreements, compliance with Treasury Board Policies & Procedures, and Executive Council / Treasury Board Memoranda.

The Director provides advice to the Ministers, Deputy Ministers and Directors of the Department on all initiatives, programs and activities.

The Director and other staff assigned to the Department will provide financial support for capital projects and contract negotiations.

Duties will include but are not limited to:

Provide overall direction and leadership on the financial administration of the Department;
Direct the budget planning, forecasting and reporting processes, and provide leadership in setting financial objectives for the Department;
Advise and assist directors and managers in quarterly forecasting and annual budget preparations;
Develop annual departmental Operating and Capital Budgets;
Develop and monitor an appropriate system of internal controls to help safeguard the department and further its objectives. An effective system of internal controls function to minimize risks and protect assets, ensure accuracy of records, promote operational efficiency, and encourage adherence to policies, regulations, and legislation;
Provide high quality advice, assistance, and information to the Minister, Deputy Minister, and Department Divisions pertaining to the financial implications on strategic and operational planning;
Provide expert, contextualized advice on the financial implications for current policy and legislation and provide leadership and direction to planning, policy analysis and development, and legislative initiatives;
Provide overall direction and leadership to the financial administration of Capital projects;
Assist in negotiating federal cost shared agreements and administer specified financial responsibilities with respect to these agreements, including: coordinating claims, maintaining prescribed accountability measures, and managing audit processes;
Directing work plans and managing performance;
Other related duties.

Minimum Qualifications:

Applicants must have a Degree in Business Administration or related field, and a Professional Accounting Designation.
Extensive experience in leadership and financial management at a senior level, preferably management within the Public Service.
Requires extensive knowledge of enterprise-wide financial information systems or similar financial system.
Must have sound knowledge of accounting and audit principles.
Requires excellent organizational and communication skills, strong interpersonal, leadership, conflict resolution, and collaborative skills and the ability to plan and think strategically.
Excellent written/verbal communication skills are required.
Strong knowledge of Oracle, PeopleSoft, and internal computer applications (i.e. Excel, etc.) would be considered beneficial.
Demonstrated problem solving ability with the ability to negotiate with and motivate others.

Benefits:

4 weeks paid vacation annually, as per the Terms and Conditions for Excluded Employees
Up to $2,500 annual training funds
Hybrid options within PEI
Flexible working hours
Employee assistance program
Pension Plan
Employer-paid health and dental benefits

This competition may be used to fill future job vacancies.

Please Note: Please ensure the application clearly demonstrates how you meet the noted qualifications as applicants will be screened based on the information provided. We would like to thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Where possible, submitting an electronic resume or job application is preferred. Otherwise, please return forms to PEI Public Service Commission, P.O. Box 2000, Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, C1A 7N8.

IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE APPLICANT TO CONFIRM RECEIPT OF THE APPLICATION, BY TELEPHONE OR IN PERSON PRIOR TO THE CLOSING DATE.

Please ensure that the appropriate Posting ID number is stated on all application forms.
